description: A dark, moody oil-style painting of many identical cylindrical metal storage tanks with domed lids, arranged in rows across a flat plain. A two-lane road with dashed centre lines runs diagonally through the lower half, and a large tank sits in the bottom-right corner. The sky is heavy, dark clouds with a faint glow on the horizon. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing violent or nude. The era is industrial and roughly modern, with no clear dated cues.
